Do not take any more cards. Your hand is already the best possible total in blackjack.

- The only outcomes of hitting are a bust or a wasted card that changes nothing.

It does not matter that the dealer shows a 2 — that never changes the math. Hitting a 21 is always a mistake, no matter what the dealer has.

* Meowbot’s Simple Rule *
“21 is 21 — always stand.”

When the dealer shows a 10 and you have a 3, you should Hit.
Take one more card and try to improve your hand.
variants.reason:
A 3 is one of the weakest hands in blackjack.

No matter what the dealer shows:
- 3 cannot win on its own.
- You must improve your hand.
- Any card 2 or higher makes your hand stronger.
- There is zero downside to hitting here.
